resources.string: Waiting for the game to finish its UPnP check.
The router accepted the game’s UDP port mapping. Friends outside your Wi-Fi can try the external address and port below.
The game could not open the UDP port. Check the router’s UPnP settings or forward the port manually to the phone’s Wi-Fi address.
The game did not find a router offering UPnP port mapping. Enable UPnP on the router or forward the UDP port manually to the phone’s Wi-Fi address.
The server started without a recorded UPnP result. UPnP may be disabled in its settings. Check the server log or configure forwarding manually.
This game library does not provide the required UPnP functions. Configure UDP port forwarding manually on the router.
UDP port: %1$s\nRouter external address: %2$s\nPhone Wi-Fi address: %3$s

The router reports a non-public address. Another router or your provider may be doing NAT. Forwarding on this router alone may not be enough; check upstream forwarding, a public IP, or a shared VPN network.
Internet access has not been verified. Confirm by connecting from another network, such as mobile data.

Launch normally, then select Host in the game. The server starts only when you create it.

On Build 42, give the server at least 2 GB of memory when you create it. That is only the server’s share: the game itself needs its own memory on top of it, so hosting needs a powerful phone with plenty of RAM.

Hosting uses a separate profile: your usual saves, mods and game settings are hidden while this switch is on and come back when you turn it off. The game gets a 2 GB memory limit and runs without debug mode. Background hosting is not guaranteed.

Hosting on Build 41 needs two libraries: libRakNet64.so and libZNetNoSteam64.so. They come from the android folder of version 42.12. You can download them from Steam if you own the game there, or load them from a file with the archive if you have already downloaded it.
Experimental feature, bugs are possible. Launch normally, then choose Host in the game. For normal play, turn it off again.
While server hosting is on, the game starts with its own profile: your usual saves, mods and game settings are not shown there. To play as usual, turn the switch off again.
